name: New Hamburg
title: Hudson River Paddling Conditions Near New Hamburg, NY
blurb: At the mouth of Wappinger Creek, on the quiet reach between the Highlands and Poughkeepsie. The creek is sheltered water when the river is blowing, and the tide runs a good half hour ahead of Poughkeepsie.

tide.label: NOAA 8518939 New Hamburg
tide.note: Tide from NOAA station 8518939 at New Hamburg, a third of a mile from the launch.
tide.cardNote: Unless you plan on landing on a beach or poking into a shallow creek, tide is likely not very important to you.

current.label: NOAA ACT3741_1 New Hamburg
current.note: Current from NOAA station ACT3741_1 at New Hamburg, a few hundred yards from the launch. Flood and ebb headings are the river’s own axis here.
